articles.title: Global banks test tokenized money for cross-border payments in $1 million BIS pilot
articles.snippet: Twenty-eight banks, including JPMorgan, Citi and UBS, moved real money across borders in a live test of blockchain-based settlement.

articles.title: Bitcoin analysts agree the Fed's hold was hawkish. They are split on what happens next.
articles.snippet: Four analysts agree the Fed's hawkish hold changes the calculus for risk assets, but they split on whether bitcoin's real test is already here or still six weeks away.
